Only regions listed in build_regions get audio. A line key in text/overworld_lines.json system_company_voice that carries its own region tag ("region": "region_1" | 1, or "regions": [...]) is voiced iff that tag is in build_regions; an untagged key falls back to the bases listed under regions.<r>.keys (a base also covers its variants <base>_2.._<base>_9). Each new region adds its own block (keys + names + numbers). Text Bot owns the lines; this file only says which ones get a voice.
